po_ref_example: PO-004471 (prefix PO-, zero padded to 6 digits)
layout_notes: Invoices often state quantities and prices in packs (CS/BX); convert with the item page.
Driver/receiving clerk often writes the received count by hand next to the printed qty; a printed qty may be struck out and replaced by the handwritten count.
Our PO number is quoted in the form PO-004471 (prefix PO-, zero padded to 6 digits) on their paperwork.
